Changes server-wide security policy. Command inputs may execute when protection is triggered and may contain secrets; they are sensitive arguments and are sent once as form data. Omitted options retain server defaults; explicit zero and false remain supplied values.

Preserve minutes versus seconds: lookback_time is seconds, lookback_period_min is minutes, and brute-force periods have explicit minute/second names. mark_as_brute describes a two-week block while the excessive-brute command description refers to a one-day block; these pinned descriptions are retained without reconciling their durations.

ipBasedProtection=false precludes firewall-block and IP-period settings per source. can_temp_ban_firewall=0 also makes those capabilities unavailable. The optional nullable warning and conditional restart_ssh remain distinct from omission; no restart behavior is inferred from an absent field.

Changes server-wide security policy. Command inputs may execute when protection is triggered and may contain secrets; they are sensitive arguments and are sent once as form data. Omitted options retain server defaults; explicit zero and false remain supplied values.

Preserve minutes versus seconds: lookback_time is seconds, lookback_period_min is minutes, and brute-force periods have explicit minute/second names. mark_as_brute describes a two-week block while the excessive-brute command description refers to a one-day block; these pinned descriptions are retained without reconciling their durations.

The key selects the interpretation of value: integer flags, minutes/seconds, failure counts, command strings or comma-separated country codes. The scalar string|int union is preserved without inventing per-key validation.
